grandChildFromChild2ActionId.description: Action ID associated with {@link ObservabilityTestType#grandChild} when invoked from {@link ObservabilityTestType#child2}.

childActionIds.description:
Action IDs associated with child spans.
Keys can be "child_0", "child_1", ..., or custom names.

grandChildActionIds.description:
Action IDs associated with grandchild spans.
Keys can be "grandChild_from_child_0", etc.
